title: Local Flow: model setup and voice following
description: Set up optional English-only Local Flow on a supported Mac, download models explicitly, and troubleshoot microphone and offline use.
body:
# Local Flow: model setup and voice following

Local Flow is optional voice following for the native Quickque app. It uses an English streaming speech model and a separate speech-activity detector on an Apple Silicon Mac. Recognition happens locally after the models are installed; the browser preview supports manual reading only.

Flow is not a recording tool. Selected-microphone audio and recognition events are temporary memory buffers. Quickque does not save recordings or transcripts, add them to backups, upload them, or offer automatic speaker identification. English-only following and ordinary interruptions are the safe assumptions.

## Before you begin

- Use an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 26 or newer with the native Quickque app.
- Confirm the native build has the Flow helper available. Intel Macs, browser preview, Windows, and Linux do not provide a native Flow fallback.
- Have a microphone connected. Quickque captures the selected microphone, not system audio.
- Be ready to download the model files before going offline. The explicit download is separate from microphone permission.

## Steps

1. Open a script in the desktop reader and change the mode selector from **Manual Scroll** to **Voice Follow**.

2. If the model is not installed, the panel **Voice Following (Flow)** explains the one-time setup. Select **Download & Install**. This action downloads the required model files explicitly; checking model status alone does not download anything or request microphone access.

3. Wait for **Downloading Model...** to finish. You can select **Cancel**, but a canceled or incomplete download is not treated as installed. The native helper verifies the downloaded files before making the model available.

4. When the panel says **Local model ready. Start when you are ready to speak.**, select **Start microphone**. macOS asks for microphone permission at this point, not during model status checks or model download.

5. Speak the English words in your script. When Flow confidently matches your words, the reader follows the matching position and shows **Following**. If it hears speech that does not match the script, it continues listening without pretending the script advanced.

6. Select the play/pause control or **Space** to pause. Leave the reader or change the mode back to **Manual Scroll** to end Flow capture, then continue with ordinary playback.

7. If you stop speaking, note the status **Listening stopped after 30 seconds without speech.** Select **Restart listening** when you are ready. Off-script speech counts as speech, so it keeps the session alive even when it does not move the marker.

## Expected result

The model is explicitly installed and then used offline by the native helper. Microphone permission is requested only when you start capture. Matching English speech moves the reader; pausing or changing mode ends capture. No audio recording or transcript file is created.

## Troubleshooting

- **The panel says browser preview supports manual reading only:** expected. Open the native Mac app; do not look for a cloud or browser fallback.
- **The panel says Flow is unsupported:** check that the app is running on a supported Apple Silicon Mac. Intel, Windows, Linux, and browser environments are outside the native Flow target.
- **Download did not finish or the model is damaged:** select **Reinstall model** from a Flow error, or return to Voice Follow and choose **Download & Install** again. Flow fails closed instead of repairing silently during microphone startup.
- **Microphone permission is missing:** macOS grants access when **Start microphone** is selected. Check the app's microphone permission in macOS settings, then retry. Quickque never captures system audio.
- **Flow does not follow:** speak the script's English words clearly and keep the intended section selected. Flow follows confident matches; it is not speaker identification and does not promise a match for every voice or wording.
- **It stopped after silence:** 30 seconds without detected speech stops capture. Select **Restart listening**; it is not an error or a recording recovery.
- **A second person is talking:** there is no automatic speaker ID. Pause Flow when another person is speaking or when an interruption should not influence the reader.
- **You expected the first run to work offline:** model download must finish before you disconnect. After a successful installation, Start uses offline mode; it does not download while requesting the microphone.

The Parakeet model weights use the NVIDIA Open Model License; they are not covered by Quickque's code license. See [Privacy and local storage](/guide/privacy/) and [Phone Remote](/guide/phone-remote/) for the other local boundaries.
